normalization: Five annual attributable profits, end-of-fiscal-year currency converted to latest published May IPCA at June selection, then median; no June IPCA used
capitalization: Issued ON and each PN class at its own observed cutoff close; no ON/PN price proxy. Issued-capital convention includes treasury shares, conservative on price gate; not EPS denominator.
payout: FRE reported adjusted-profit payout, including source-specific reserve/JCP net-versus-gross conventions; not silently treated as proven reinvestment retention
reinvestment: No premium approval without adjusted class EPS, five-year retained-profit reconciliation, three-year sector-appropriate return and objective solvency evidence
quality: Six dimensions require positive dated documentary conclusions; blank, pending or a retrieved report with unattested publication never grants QUALIFIED
stock_coverage: Inherited qualified corporate-action coverage; no claim of complete original issuance-event certification
